title: "Workbook Map"
subtitle: "Every page, deck, video and kit: what it does, where it lands and when it last changed"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

This page lists **every object in the workbook**, so you can scan or search
(`Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`F`) all of it at once. Each entry links to where the object lands.
Use the contents on the right to jump between sections.

| Date | What it means |
|---|---|
| Baseline | One date for everything, set by the baseline edition (Release 2.0) once the books have been checked against each other |
| Last updated | The last time the object itself changed. Edition numbers in links and review records don't count |
| Last verified | The last time the page was reviewed, or its claims were checked against their sources |

: The dates in this map {.striped}

A **Last updated** date later than **Last verified** means the page has changed since it was last checked.

::: {.callout-note}
This map is **generated on every site build** by
[`scripts/generate_workbook_map.py`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/modernization-workbook/blob/main/scripts/generate_workbook_map.py),
so it always matches the site. To regenerate it locally without a full build:

```bash
python scripts/generate_workbook_map.py
```
:::
